a.xlink:title: FreeRTOS task: process inbound ESP-NOW protocol events.
Apply motion configuration from global settings to the motion controller.
Set acceleration for oscillation (direct TMC5160 AMAX control).

Set target cycle count (0 = infinite).
Cancel de-energize timer (e.g., when test starts).
Get bounds validity flag for protocol status updates.
Get current completed cycles.
Invalidate bounds (e.g., on config change or explicit request).
Mark bounds as freshly found and start de-energize timer.

Immediately stop motion and enter HOLD mode, but keep motor energized.
Immediately stop motion, enter HOLD, and de-energize (disable) the motor.
Pause active motion (stops movement but keeps motor energized for resume).
Run bounds finding independently (without starting test).
Reset cycle counter and completion flags.
Send ERROR message.
Send STATUS_UPDATE with cycle count and state.
Set global (hardware) bounds in degrees.
Set local oscillation bounds (degrees) relative to the center.
Start active motion.
Request a START/RESUME with optional bounds caching.
Restore motor current to full rated level after manual bounds positioning.
Send CONFIG_ACK for a CONFIG_SET request.
Send CONFIG_RESPONSE containing the current settings.
Send PAUSE_ACK (acknowledge PAUSE receipt).
Send RESUME_ACK (acknowledge RESUME receipt).
Send START_ACK (acknowledge START receipt).
Send STOP_ACK (acknowledge STOP receipt).
Set motor current to a reduced level for manual bounds engagement.
Stop active motion and command driver stop.
Map the internal application state machine to the protocol-visible TestState.
Check if bounds are still valid (within time window and motor energized).
FreeRTOS task: perform bounds finding, then start motion.
Get current driver configuration.
Read current global bounds (degrees).
Read local bounds (degrees).
Get remaining time until bounds expire (seconds).
Initialize the TMC51x0 driver with configuration.
Send BOUNDS_RESULT message.
